{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print("Number of internal test orders found:")
print(internal_test_mask.sum())

# Identify completed orders
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'

# Combine: completed AND not internal test
valid_orders = df[completed_mask & ~internal_test_mask]

# Calculate total revenue from valid completed orders
total_revenue = valid_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue"}
